_readme: Template for the PRIVATE benchmark generator parameters.
Copy to benchmarks/private/params.json (git-ignored), set a seed, then run:
The seed plus these values fully determine the hidden answers.
Never commit the private copy and never paste it (or the generated pack/manifest) into a chat.
_band_width: How wide a 'defensible' ROI range is: 0.35 means truth +/-35%.
_high_value_floor_usd: Annual value below this does not count as a must-find opportunity.
_labor_rates_usd_per_hour: Fully loaded cost (wage x ~1.4 for benefits/overhead), USD/hour.
_automatable_fraction: Share of the observed labor an AI intervention can realistically remove.
